title: Work tape reads the reversed bit
statement: Let $x$ be a binary word and let $i<|x|$. In the test configuration on input $x$ with the input head at position $i+1$, the work head at integer position $|x|-1-i$, and the first $|x|$ bits copied, the symbol under the work head is the bit of the reversal of $x$ at position $i$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary word of length $n$ and $i < n$. In the test-state
configuration of the palindrome machine on input $x$ with input head at cell
$i+1$, all $n$ bits copied, and work head at the integer cell $n-1-i$, the symbol
under the work head is the $i$-th bit of the reversal $x^{R}$.
